theme: electricity grid connections reform and queue management

sources.title: Connect update: demand connections reform
sources.facts: Published 16 June 2026; describes Curate, Plan and Connect work on demand-queue viability, prioritisation and network constraints.
sources.guard: Policy direction does not prove a project has capacity, priority, an offer or a connection date.

sources.title: Demand connections reform
sources.role: call for input and response record
sources.facts: Sets out demand-queue challenges and reform options; consultation material is not a final project decision.
sources.guard: Consultation evidence does not establish adopted rules or site-specific connection rights.

sources.title: Decision on Connections Reform Package (TMO4+)
sources.facts: Decision published 15 April 2025 enabling ready-and-needed criteria, code modifications, methodologies and licence changes.
sources.guard: An enabling decision does not prove an individual scheme meets Gate 2 or receives a confirmed offer.

sources.title: Connections Reform design documents and methodologies
sources.facts: Hosts June 2026 methodology documents and prior approved Gate 2, project designation and network design materials.
sources.guard: A methodology library does not constitute a completed evidence assessment for a specific project.

sources.title: About Connections Reform
sources.facts: Explains Gate 1, Gate 2 and the Gate 2 to Whole Queue process and strategic alignment/readiness concepts.
sources.guard: Overview status does not prove exact queue position, capacity, readiness or delivery.

sources.title: Queue management
sources.facts: Explains CMP376 and updates following CMP434/CMP435 and TMO4+ changes.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove milestones were met or that termination, retention or acceleration occurred.

sources.title: Electricity networks: connections action plan
sources.facts: Published 22 November 2023; sets direction, oversight and expected pace for connections reform.
sources.guard: An action plan does not secure network works, funding, consent or a project connection.

sources.title: Evidence handbook and other G2WQ submission resources
sources.facts: Lists detailed-check guidance, submission handbook, templates and readiness resources for G2WQ.
sources.guard: Submission guidance does not prove evidence was accepted or a Gate 2 contract was awarded.

package_guard: Grid policy, reform decisions, methodologies, queue guidance and submission resources do not by themselves prove exact-site capacity, viable connection, queue position, Gate 2 status, offer terms, connection date, network reinforcement, consent, funding or energisation.
